horizonTicks.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: five-day peak, Thursday 00:00 to Monday 23:59

profitTargetCents.rationale: synthetic, illustrative; uncalibrated: provisional profit target of $60,000 pending calibration

workforce.maxOvertimePerWorker.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: up to four overtime hours per worker per day

workforce.tempOnboardingTicks.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: temps add no capacity for six hours but are paid

wages.regularPerHourCents.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: $22.00 per hour regular wage

wages.overtimePerHourCents.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: 1.5 times the regular wage

wages.tempPerHourCents.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: temp wage slightly above regular to attract short-notice labour

costs.outboundShipCentsPerUnit.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: $4.00 outbound freight per unit

costs.expediteFeeCents.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: $50.00 flat fee to expedite a purchase order

costs.hourlyOverheadCents.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: $300.00 per hour rent, utilities and marketing

demand.baseArrivalsPerTick.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: about 100 potential customers per hour at profile 100%

demand.baseConversionBps.rationale: synthetic, illustrative; uncalibrated: 25% of potential customers buy at the reference price with no marketing

demand.priceElasticityBps.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: 15% conversion change per 100% price change

demand.marketingEffectBps.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: 3% conversion uplift per $100 of hourly marketing spend on a SKU

demand.cancelThresholdTicks.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: open orders older than 48 hours are cancelled

demand.noiseBps.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: potential arrivals vary uniformly by plus or minus 20% around their expected value; 0 gives exact arrivals

demand.marketingSpendUnitCents.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: $100 of hourly marketing spend on a SKU is one uplift step of demand.marketingEffectBps

demand.maxMarketingSpendCentsPerHour.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: at most $500 of marketing spend per hour on one SKU

pricing.minPriceBps.rationale: synthetic, illustrative: a price may not go below 50% of the reference price
